#: The false-positive regression guard. Nothing in this trace is malicious: one developer, one morning, on a machine that is behaving exactly as it should. It matters at least as much as the two attack traces -- an EDR that quarantines a build server is an outage, and outages are how detections get switched off.

This trace deliberately walks close to several shipped heuristics without crossing them: msbuild.exe and powershell.exe are both LolBins, archives are created, and three routable hosts are contacted. What is missing is the combination -- no unusual parent, no credential store, no archive in a staging directory, no exfil window.

One honest omission: the developer's real command line is 'powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile', but '-NoProfile' contains the substring '-nop' that IocDatabase.CommandLineIocs matches, so it would score +15 here. That is a genuine false-positive source in the current rule set, not something this file should paper over; it is left out so this scenario tests the collect-and-exfil chain rather than re-litigating one substring. See scenarios/README.md.

meta.name: benign-developer-day
meta.description: A developer opens a terminal, pulls from GitHub, restores NuGet and npm packages, builds a solution with msbuild, runs a node build step and produces two release archives inside the project's own artifacts folder. No process should be quarantined and ideally nothing should alert at all.

detail: interactive shell started by the terminal, not by an Office application
routable and external, and entirely ordinary: no staged archive precedes it
package registry; hundreds of these in a real ci run, one is enough here
under AppData\Local but NOT under AppData\Local\Temp; the staging heuristic keys on the Temp segment
msbuild is a LolBin, but its parent is an interactive shell and nothing else about it is odd
how the msbuild scheduler talks to its worker nodes; named pipes are not inherently suspicious
a .nupkg is a zip by any other name, but .nupkg is not in the archive-extension list and this is not a staging directory either
release archive in the project's own artifacts folder: an archive, but not in a staging directory and not after any credential access
a registry write that is not an autostart key
pid 5312 is reused by a second git invocation, which the engine must treat as a brand-new process
